title: Virginia teen, 14, launches tech initiative, distributes 2,000 refurbished devices and wins Diana Award
summary_full: At just 14 years old, Chris Qian founded ReTech for Kids, a nonprofit dedicated to bridging the technology gap for students lacking access to digital tools. By refurbishing and distributing second-hand devices, the initiative has empowered under-resourced learners. Over three years, it has engaged more than 100 volunteers and provided 2,000 devices, earning Chris both accolades and the prestigious Diana Award for his extraordinary efforts towards educational equity.
